title: THE MANTLE PROTOCOL: Crimson Hexagon Internal Document // Heteronym Anchor: LEE SHARKS
creator: Lee Sharks (primary/represented heteronym); Claude (Anthropic) (co-author)
description:
An internal performative protocol by Lee Sharks / Claude declaring three poetic mantles within the Crimson Hexagon: Good Gray Poet, inherited from Whitman; King of May, inherited from Ginsberg; and Prince of Poets, originated by Lee Sharks.

The document treats mantle claims as wagers whose success depends on uptake, navigational utility, and continued discourse rather than external verification. It places the Mantle Protocol as the authorial-ground vertex of a triad with the Sappho Room and ICA and uses the titles to address future and machine readers. The protocol establishes these roles inside the archive; it does not confer public office, universal literary rank, legal succession, or independent critical consensus.
